job.title: SAP Data Migration Consultant
job.description:
This is: the job
Join a major SAP S/4HANA transformation where data quality is a critical part of delivering a successful migration. The organisation is migrating data from a range of legacy environments, including D365 to S/4HANA, with a strong focus across FI/CO and MM.

This is a hands-on data role, where you will get into the detail of the data, working with business SMEs and functional teams to determine what should migrate, what needs cleansing or rationalising, and how information should map into S/4HANA.

You will own assigned data objects across the migration lifecycle, from scoping and source-to-target mapping through cleansing, migration, reconciliation, defect resolution, dress rehearsals and production cutover.

This is: what you'll do
  • Analyse legacy MS Dynamics ERP and other source-system data to identify duplicates, inconsistencies and data quality issues
  • Drive hands-on data cleansing, de-duplication and rationalisation across multiple legacy environments
  • Collaborate with business SMEs to resolve incomplete, conflicting or duplicate records and determine the appropriate migration treatment
  • Define and maintain source-to-target mappings between legacy platforms and SAP S/4HANA
  • Manage assigned data objects through migration cycles, including mock conversions, dress rehearsals and production cutover
  • Deliver pre-load and post-load validation, reconciliation and data integrity checks
  • Investigate migration defects, identify root causes and coordinate resolution across business, functional and technical teams
  • Support migration of FI/CO and MM data, including procurement and purchase order-related information
  • Maintain clear documentation covering mapping, cleansing, validation, defects, risks, dependencies and migration outcomes
  • Collaborate with the Data Lead, functional consultants, testing teams, developers, business SMEs and delivery partners throughout the transformation
This is: what you'll need
  • Significant hands-on SAP data migration experience gained within large ERP or S/4HANA transformation programs
  • Strong experience across data cleansing, mapping, transformation, reconciliation and validation
  • Demonstrated success working with poor-quality, duplicated or inconsistent legacy data
  • Experience migrating data from non-SAP or legacy ERP environments into SAP S/4HANA
  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or AX 2012 will be highly regarded
  • Strong SAP data knowledge across FI/CO and/or MM
  • Experience with procurement and purchase order-related data is highly desirable
  • Understanding of both SAP master and transactional data structures
  • Experience owning data objects through multiple migration cycles, dress rehearsals and production cutover
  • Strong source-to-target mapping, defect investigation and root-cause analysis capability
  • Confidence working directly with business SMEs to resolve complex data issues and make migration decisions
  • Experience within multi-ERP environments involving overlapping data is highly regarded
  • Knowledge of data governance, quality controls and regulated or audit-controlled environments such as JSOX will be advantageous
This is: the perks
  • Play a hands-on role in a significant S/4HANA transformation with a complex multi-system data landscape
  • Tackle meaningful data challenges created by legacy systems and acquisition activity
  • Build further S/4HANA transformation experience across Finance, Procurement and Materials Management data

job.title: Product Owner
job.description:
This is: the job

An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Product Owner to join a high-performing digital commerce team on an initial 3-month contract, with the potential to develop into a permanent opportunity.

This role sits at the centre of several business-critical initiatives supporting customer-facing platforms, including CRM systems, website product catalogues and the underlying technology integrations that enable seamless customer experiences.

You’ll work across three to four concurrent projects, providing clear product direction, structure and delivery leadership. More than maintaining a backlog, you’ll define what good looks like, establish meaningful product metrics and connect delivery priorities to measurable business and customer outcomes.

The environment includes complex solutions, customised builds and interdependent systems. You’ll need to quickly understand the broader product landscape, form a clear vision and drive progress across business and technology teams.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who brings genuine ownership to digital product management. You’ll help shape how products are managed, strengthen Agile and Jira practices, and create an environment in which priorities, accountabilities and outcomes are clear.

This is: what you’ll do

  • Lead the delivery of multiple concurrent digital and technology initiatives
  • Define and communicate a clear product vision, including what successful outcomes look like
  • Take end-to-end ownership of digital products, from discovery and prioritisation through to delivery and optimisation
  • Establish meaningful product metrics and connect those measures to customer and business outcomes
  • Manage and prioritise product backlogs based on value, complexity, risk and strategic objectives
  • Drive progress across complex solutions, customised builds and integrated technology environments
  • Shape effective Agile delivery practices and establish clear, practical ways of working in Jira
  • Manage project plans, timelines, risks, dependencies and reporting
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to define priorities, requirements and outcomes
  • Coordinate delivery across CRM, website, product catalogue and integration-related initiatives
  • Provide clear communication, status reporting and escalation management
  • Identify gaps in current product practices and lead continuous improvement across the digital product environment

This is: what you’ll need
  • Demonstrated experience as a Product Owner responsible for complex digital products or solutions
  • Proven ability to create a product vision and turn it into clear priorities, delivery plans and measurable outcomes
  • Experience working with customised solutions, bespoke builds and interconnected technology platforms
  • Strong understanding of product metrics, including defining measures and connecting them to customer and business outcomes
  • Experience establishing or improving digital product management practices
  • Strong working knowledge of Agile delivery methodologies and the ability to shape effective ways of working
  • Advanced practical experience using Jira to manage backlogs, workflows, priorities and delivery visibility
  • Strong experience within CRM, website-powered or digital commerce environments
  • Demonstrated ability to lead progress rather than simply administer an existing delivery process
  • Experience delivering multiple projects or workstreams simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation and communication skills
  • Ability to quickly understand a complex environment and contribute with minimal onboarding
  • Strong organisational, planning and problem-solving capability
  • Experience working across business, technology, vendor and delivery teams
This is: the perks
  • Take genuine ownership of several business-critical digital initiatives
  • Define what good product management looks like and shape the broader delivery environment
  • Work across complex customer-facing platforms, customised solutions and technology integrations
  • Potential to move from the initial contract into a longer-term permanent opportunity

job.title: SAP Reporting and Analytics Lead
job.description:
This is: the job

An opportunity exists for an experienced SAP Reporting and Analytics Lead to join a major SAP S/4HANA transformation program in Melbourne. This is a 12 month contract in a hybrid environment, suited to a hands-on leader who can shape reporting strategy while staying close to design, delivery and quality.

You will lead the reporting and analytics workstream across the SAP analytics landscape, including SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, embedded analytics and Fiori-based reporting. The role will translate business reporting needs into a clear, governed analytics architecture and ensure dashboards, reports, KPIs and data models are trusted from go-live.

This is a high-impact role working across data, functional, technical and business teams. You will partner with senior stakeholders, guide delivery resources, challenge legacy reporting habits and help build a reporting capability that supports better decisions across a complex enterprise environment.

This is: what you'll do
  • Lead the reporting and analytics workstream across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere and embedded analytics
  • Define the target-state analytics architecture, reporting strategy, standards and roadmap
  • Drive requirements workshops with business stakeholders and functional leads across statutory, operational, management and self-service reporting
  • Oversee the design and build of reports, dashboards, KPIs, semantic models, CDS views and analytical data model.
  • Manage reporting governance, including naming conventions, KPI definitions, version control, lineage and business glossary alignment
  • Drive report rationalisation by challenging legacy lift-and-shift requests and promoting standardisation
  • Collaborate with data migration, master data, security, integration and technical architecture teams to ensure reporting is secure, scalable and supportable
  • Manage reporting test strategy across SIT, UAT and reconciliation against source and legacy systems
  • Lead reporting developers, analysts and partner resources to deliver the reporting backlog
  • Support transition to operations, including hypercare, support processes, knowledge transfer and documentation
This is: what you'll need
  • Proven experience leading reporting or analytics workstreams on a full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation
  • Strong working knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Data Products and S/4HANA embedded analytics
  • Experience with CDS views, Fiori analytical apps, semantic models, dashboards and SAP reporting architecture
  • Solid understanding of SAP data models and reporting-relevant modules such as FI/CO, MM, SD, PP or similar
  • Experience defining data governance standards, KPI definitions, reconciliation controls and reporting quality frameworks
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage senior business, technology and delivery stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to lead mixed teams of analysts, developers and implementation partner resources
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the confidence to balance standardisation against genuine business need
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to technical and executive audiences
  • A degree in business, technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
This is: the perks
  • Lead a critical analytics workstream on a major SAP S/4HANA transformation
  • Shape the reporting architecture, governance model and Day 1 decision-support capability
  • Work with senior stakeholders across data, technology, functional teams and business reporting ownership
